name: Diregraf Captain — "target opponent" in a trigger leaves the lord effect alone
notes: Found behind an inert check of the subject probe in tests/sweep.py (2026-10-13). _finalizeEffects tied every global effect of a card to the chosen opponent whenever the words 'target opponent' stood anywhere in its text, so 'Other Zombie creatures you control get +1/+1' reached nobody: the words belong to the dies trigger on the next line. On a permanent they now count only outside triggered and activated abilities.
